notes: Build78 Emergency Kill Switch is a diagnostic containment release for the Chrome-wide freeze/memory incident. The shipped runtime package contains only manifest.json and icons. It has no background service worker, no content scripts, no permissions, no host permissions, no web accessible runtime resources, and therefore executes no Lovable Decrypter code in lovable.dev or in the extension background. This release intentionally disables all Decrypter functionality so browser stability can be isolated from extension runtime execution.
